topics.title: Understanding Club Rotation
topics.subtitle: Where the center of rotation lives during the swing
topics.defaultPrompt: I see the clubhead move on an arc, but help me understand the center of rotation of the club. During the different phases of the swing, where is the club's rotation center relative to my hands? Should I feel the center of rotation in my hands, or is it outside the hands?
